source_search.interpretation: The private pre-existing consistency::Budget implements Write to count serialized per-request evidence bytes without another JSON buffer. Lifecycle::observe uses it before retaining item/text evidence. It is unchanged from HEAD, has no RunRequest/CLI integration, and is not the deleted run-limit feature or a new cache reservation system. Historical planning/verification references and explicit negative tests may name deleted policy. Static matches alone do not prove behavior; controller and tool control flow/assertions were reviewed.

retained_constraints.setting: 1 MiB serialized input and session configuration; 1..128 input items per request; nonempty user text/instructions; model name at most 256 bytes.
retained_constraints.purpose_effect: Bounds individual configuration/input payloads and rejects invalid shape before admission. MAX_INPUT_ITEMS=128 is existing request compatibility, not a lifetime execution allowance.

retained_constraints.setting: 32 declared tools; tool name 1..64 ASCII alphanumeric/underscore/hyphen bytes; description at most 8192 bytes; object parameter schema; call IDs 1..512 UTF-8 bytes; tool arguments and serialized output at most 64 KiB.
retained_constraints.purpose_effect: Bounds declaration/execution payloads and enforces identity/schema/authority. Oversized tool output becomes a correlated tool_output_limit error result; i64 addition uses checked arithmetic. No eight-call or lifetime cache-count gate remains.

retained_constraints.setting: 2048 retained history items and 8 MiB serialized history; exactly the outstanding tool-result IDs before continuation.
retained_constraints.purpose_effect: Bounds retained/replayed provider context without automatic compaction and rejects missing/unknown/duplicate results. Can still stop long tasks; not a universal cache/RSS bound.
Bounds decoded output shape; unknown/nonterminal status and malformed output reject. Preserved native items do not grant execution authority.

retained_constraints.setting: Consistency tracking: 4096 events, 512 finalized occurrences, item/content indexes below 512, 1 MiB cumulative serialized item-event/text accounting.
retained_constraints.purpose_effect: Counts duplicate evidence before retaining copies and rejects conflicting provisional/effective output before settlement. Text copies remain bounded; validated terminal uncertainty is not rewritten. The private byte Budget is pre-existing.

retained_constraints.setting: Recovery: 4096 observed events, 512 items/indexes below 512, 1 MiB cumulative serialized item-event occurrences; IDs/function names at most 512 bytes; recovered argument JSON object at most 1 MiB.
retained_constraints.purpose_effect: Bounds complete finalized evidence and fails closed on overflow/identity/lifecycle conflicts. Only eligible explicit-empty successful terminals recover; the executor still applies its stricter 64 KiB argument guard.

retained_constraints.setting: 8 MiB WebSocket message/frame and SSE frame limits; 32 MiB cumulative response bytes.
retained_constraints.purpose_effect: Bounds incoming frame/response parsing. SSE fetched bytes are checked before conversion/retention and prolog replay is not charged twice.

retained_constraints.setting: Missing-MIME SSE prolog: 65536 raw bytes, absolute 10 seconds, response ID 1..512 UTF-8 bytes; diagnostic body classifier at most 4096 bytes. Ordinary rejection sampling: 4096 bytes and 1 second.
retained_constraints.purpose_effect: First data frame must prove a recognized response before ordinary decoding on the same POST. Bad present MIME/non-2xx reject; diagnostics are opt-in and do not relax admission or retry.

retained_constraints.setting: Provider connect 15 seconds, receive idle 90 seconds, request total 600 seconds, consumer stall 30 seconds; SSE HTTP read 90 seconds/total 600 seconds; admission queue 1, event queue 64 plus one terminal slot.
retained_constraints.purpose_effect: Bounds a provider operation or blocked consumer, not elapsed controller lifetime or a tool wait between requests. One active generation per session; terminal fallback closes the session. No controller retry/reconnect/fallback.

retained_constraints.setting: Opt-in smoke observation: diagnostic counts saturate at 4096 per request; diagnostic text at most 1 MiB.
retained_constraints.purpose_effect: Bounds private comparison evidence and reports safe static categories/counts, not raw secrets. Normal sessions do not allocate this optional observation state; these are not generic run quotas.

retained_constraints.setting: External auth file at most 1 MiB; regular file, no-follow open, Unix group/other permission bits forbidden; expiry rejected within 30 seconds.
retained_constraints.purpose_effect: Bounds local parsing and protects credentials. Tokens/headers use redaction, sensitive flags and zeroizing storage; explicit source selection and account affinity remain. Source reviewed only; no real credential file read.

retained_constraints.setting: Managed store at most 1 MiB; owner-only 0700 directory/0600 files; regular single-link files and no-follow access; profile aliases 1..64 permitted ASCII bytes; nonblocking lock retry window 1 second, with 10 ms waits.
retained_constraints.purpose_effect: Protects strict versioned auth data and atomic persistence. Stable locking, incarnation/account binding, reauth guards and owned renewal persistence remain; other locking paths may block. No auth policy redesign.

retained_constraints.setting: Browser login total 180 seconds; launcher 10 seconds with 20 ms polling; callback at most 8192 bytes; token/refresh connect/read 10 seconds, exchange 30 seconds, response at most 65536 bytes; state and PKCE verifier each use 32 random bytes.
retained_constraints.purpose_effect: Bounds separately authorized auth flows and validates loopback callback/state, fixed-TLS token source and expiry. No proxy/redirect/retry; rejected OAuth bodies are not exposed. These commands were NOT RUN for C1.

retained_constraints.setting: Fixed subscription WS/SSE destinations; TLS; no automatic proxy, redirect, retry, reconnect, fallback or mid-session account switch.
retained_constraints.purpose_effect: Protects credential destination and prevents ambiguous resubmission or connection identity changes. WS retains handshake credentials; SSE prepares/reloads the same bound account for each submission. No new provider/connection lifecycle feature.

numeric_policy_note: Exact numeric settings are Wi choices, not automatically provider requirements or proven optimal values. C1 preserves these scoped safeguards; this is not a usefulness audit of all code.

test_supervision.settings: L uses an external 5-second test watchdog; paused-time tests use a 1-second post-release/cancel watchdog. Loopback-only connect/idle are 3 seconds, total 10 seconds, consumer 100 ms. CLI retest helper uses 180000 ms with 1000 ms termination grace; line 8 MiB, total 64 MiB, stderr 64 KiB, text 1 MiB and IDs 512 bytes.
test_supervision.effect: Supervises finite tests/fixed subprocess cases outside the product controller. Only the Node self-test was run; the live runner was NOT RUN and unauthorized. No detached production tool worker or timer API was added.
